     ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION

         EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

       Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation

(together, “Applicants”) object to the following exhibits listed in Attachment 1, because these exhibits

are not pre-filed direct testimony or discovery responses, are duplicative, constitute late-filed direct

testimony, or were not uploaded to the Applicants’ file sharing website, Egnyte, at the time of this

filing. Accordingly, Applicants respectfully request that these exhibits not be admitted into the record

at the start of the hearing on the merits, scheduled to begin on June 8, 2026.
